High-Carbon Steel Frame

Built with a durable high-carbon steel frame, offering robust support and longevity for all types of rides

26-Inch Yellow-Rimmed Tires

Fitted with 26-inch tires featuring yellow rims, providing enhanced traction and a stylish look

21-Speed Transmission

Equipped with a 21-speed gear system for optimal performance on diverse terrains, ensuring smooth and efficient shifting

V-Brakes for Reliable Stopping

Equipped with V-brakes for reliable and responsive braking, ensuring safety in various weather conditions

Choose Ideal Size

Tailored for both men and women, the 26" adult mountain bike fits riders between 5’4’’-5’9’’ 90% pre-assembly and the tools provided

About Us

HILAND had a simple yet powerful mission — to bring the joy of cycling and a healthy, positive lifestyle to everyone. From the very beginning, HILAND set out to provide affordable, high-quality bicycles that would make the freedom of riding accessible to all.

We've got our own manufacturing facilities, so we ensure that each bike we make brings top-notch performance and affordability to our amazing customers.

Unleash your adventure with the Hiland Vortex Mountain Bike. Featuring a rugged high-tensile steel frame, Shimano 21-speed drivetrain, and front suspension for smooth trail riding.
